		limit = {
			zin_shared_lands_of_the_sun_can_join_league = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }
			}

				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }

			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = Y6U
				}
				Y6U = {
					add_to_faction = PREV
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_shared_lands_of_the_sun_join_league_tip_1
	}
}
